title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Greek Theatre, Los Angeles | 2019
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Greek Theatre in Los Angeles, California, USA, on 1 September 2019.

It was the final show of the 14th All-Starr Band’s tour of Asia and North America, which lasted for 34 dates between March and September 2019.

During the final song, ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’, they were joined by Wally Palmer, Richard Page, Edgar Winter, Eric Carmen, Joe Walsh, Jim Keltner, Nils Lofgren.

This concert was released as Starr’s 12th solo live album Live At The Greek Theater 2019.

Starr had previously performed at the Greek Theatre on 3 and 4 September 1989, 11 and 12 August 1992, 18 and 19 August 1995, 2 August 2008, 7 August 2010, 21 July 2012, 19 July 2014, 2 July 2016, and 29 September 2018. He returned there on 15 June 2023, 8 September 2024, and 14 June 2026.
